question: On the same fixed LeWM PushT tasks, does iCEM-inspired per-iteration population decay improve success or actual planner time compared with constant candidate budgets?

scope.evaluation_type: pinned-upstream-protocol-aligned dataset-driven evaluation; population-decay ablation only, not full iCEM
scope.optional_action_difference: omitted unless already available without changing the frozen evaluation path

protocol.preprocessing: reuse the existing baseline helper: full-dataset StandardScaler for action/proprio/state after NaN-row removal, goal scaler reuse, and pinned ToImage/float32/ImageNet-normalize/Resize(224) transforms
protocol.evaluator: reuse run_dataset_teacher_baseline.evaluate_selected_tasks and the pinned _set_state/_set_goal_state callables; video=None

reference_baseline.engineering_floor: at least 5/50; a continuation gate only
reference_baseline.stage1_rule: Rerun 300/30 first in this job on the exact frozen rows. Require valid finite 50-task outcomes, at least 5 successes, and exact itemwise equality to the reference 25534994 success vector. If any check fails, record the control result and stop before all other arms.

measurement.paired_unit: same 50 frozen dataset rows for every seed and arm; compare within seed and task
measurement.candidate_evaluations: sum actual B*N for every get_cost call; also retain the per-iteration schedule
measurement.planner_time: CUDA synchronized time around each solver.solve; retain both calls, total, and post-first timing
measurement.success_outcomes: complete 50-item vector per seed and arm
measurement.primary_comparisons: decay_equal_4500 versus constant 150/30 at exactly 4500 samples per environment and solve; decay_paper_125 versus 300/30 and 150/30 with unequal sample totals
measurement.gpu_telemetry: nvidia-smi utilization and memory every 5 seconds appended to job.log

validity_and_stopping.stage1: seed 42 official 300/30 must have finite 50-task outcomes, at least 5 successes, and exact per-task match to valid 25534994 reference; otherwise stop
validity_and_stopping.fail_closed: any invalid, nonfinite, incomplete, or crashing arm stops the run; retain partial evidence
validity_and_stopping.no_posthoc_extension: no replacement tasks, schedule changes, extra arms, or result-driven reruns
validity_and_stopping.inference_limit: exploratory fixed-dataset paired outcomes; no formal noninferiority, random-reset success, or full iCEM claim

compute_node_guards: PBS_NODEFILE is a real file and contains current hostname
resources.login_node_work: control only; no model/data reads or inference

papers.distinct_components: colored noise, keep/shift elites, best-action execution, clipping are outside this one-factor ablation
